name: modbee-ota
description: Firmware updates for a ModBee node over MQTT, from inside the PLC program: FB_OtaNode, on the MQTT library's FB_MqttClient, downloads, checks and switches to new firmware, and goes back to the old firmware by itself if the new one does not come back. The program decides when to accept, apply or abort, a dropped link or a power cut resumes, and the Sparkplug method puts the update on a SCADA host's screens.
